title: Reprehensible
summary: REPREHEN'SIBLE, adjective [Latin reprehensus.] Blamable; culpable; censurable; deserving reproof; applied to persons or things; as a reprehensible person; reprehensible conduct.

inlines.v: REPREHEN'SIBLE, adjective [Latin reprehensus.] Blamable; culpable; censurable; deserving reproof; applied to persons or things; as a reprehensible person; reprehensible conduct.
